items.title: Solana starts testing upgrade that could cut finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds
items.whyYouShouldCare: Reducing finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds could significantly enhance Solana's transaction efficiency, attracting more developers and users to the network.

items.title: Solana’s DEX trades overtake NYSE: Is this SOL’s next Q4 catalyst?
items.whyYouShouldCare: Solana's DEX surpassing NYSE in trades indicates growing liquidity and user engagement, potentially positioning SOL favorably for Q4 performance.

items.title: Solana flips Ethereum in fees, while ETH holds the burn lead
items.whyYouShouldCare: Solana's increase in fees over Ethereum suggests a shift in user preference, which may enhance its ecosystem's sustainability and overall market competitiveness.
